integrity: The full proof and exact reproducible checker are provided. Finite experiments corroborate but do not replace the all-parameter transfer and run classification. Independent mathematical and priority audits are not performed.
scientific_limitations: The formula is for K_m Cartesian P_n with m>=3, n>=1; it does not cover m=2, cyclic column factors or maximal nonmaximum packings. Existing 2020 literature already gives the scalar maximum cardinality; the new contribution is the bivariate enumerator and equality multiplicities. Publication priority outside inspected literature is uncertain.
title: Bivariate open-packing enumerator and extremal multiplicities for Cartesian clique–path graphs
